rationale: Phase-1 profile showed get() SCAN+sort growing 0.077->6.7ms (1k->20k) and insert-dedupe SCAN 0.23->7.5ms. Indexes should make both ~O(log n); at 20k I expect >=10x on get(), but the CONSERVATIVE floor is the smallest cell — insert() at n=1000, where the scan is only ~0.2ms and index maintenance partly offsets the win. Predicting conservative min improvement fraction = 0.5 (i.e. worst cell halves).
